name: Racemization of a doubly bridged biphenyl diketone (conformational KIE)

reference.citation: K. Mislow, E. Simon, H. B. Hopps, Tetrahedron Lett. 1962, 1011-1014
reference.method: secondary KIE on the racemization rate

reference.citation: K. Mislow, E. Simon, M. A. W. Glass, G. H. Wahl, H. B. Hopps, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1964, 86, 1710-1733
reference.method: optical stability of doubly bridged biphenyls

reference.citation: G. Grazioli, A. Ly, D. Sabetnejad, A. Mattapalli, C. T. Nguyen, D. J. O'Leary, PyQuiverHS: A Web Tool for Computing Isotope Effects, ChemRxiv 2026 (preprint, CC-BY 4.0)
reference.method: source of the frequency calculations (SI data, Gaussian 16) and of the experimental value(s) quoted here, from Table 4 (368 K; no uncertainty given); its PyQuiverHS results for the same files are in pyquiverhs/

notes: Compound 2 of Grazioli et al.; the measured value is the one quoted in their Table 4. Deuterating all eight bridge CH2 hydrogens (d8) slows racemization (normal KIE). 2-da and 2-db carry one deuterium at the two inequivalent bridge positions (atoms 27 and 28); they were not measured. The transition structure's reaction-coordinate frequency is only 45i cm-1, below Kinisot's default 50 cm-1 cutoff, hence imag_cutoff 30 (the value in the PyQuiverHS input).
